integrity: A general finite congruence-compatibility and partition-restriction argument proves the structural test. A complete 8000-map enumeration cross-checks two independent CEP methods and two independent orbit-count methods; checker.py is included. The published 8-element unrestricted census was inspected for implication comparison.
scientific_limitations: Exact enumeration applies to the eight-element Boolean carrier. The all-finite-carrier criterion does not claim polynomial-time complexity. Individual-frame CEP is not conflated with CEP of its generated variety; historical priority remains a risk.
title: Dependency-closure criterion and exact monotone CEP census for finite Boolean frames
